name: Telegram Bot
description: Remote assistant via Telegram: voice messages, camera snapshots, alarms, and bi-directional chat.
capabilities: Voice message speech-to-text and audio response

guide.title: How to create and connect your Telegram bot
steps: Open Telegram on your phone and search for @BotFather (the official bot, with the blue tick), or open the link below.
Send /newbot. Pick a name (for example “Nunzio's Home”) and then a username ending in “bot” (for example nunzio_home_bot).
BotFather replies with the token: a long line like 123456789:AAH... Copy it without spaces.
Paste the token in the “Telegram bot token” field below and press Save. Within a few seconds the bot shows as active.
To change bot, paste the new bot's token and save: the old one stops answering. Each person must open the new bot in Telegram and press Start.
To link a person: People, Connectors tab, Telegram, “Generate pairing code”, then send that code to the bot.
guide.note: The token works like a password: never share it. If it leaks, send /revoke to BotFather to get a new one.

help.NUXIVA_TELEGRAM_TOKEN: The token BotFather gave you. Paste a new one to switch bot.
